name: Decompose Monolith into Services & Add Composite Feature
description: Extract auth, telemetry, and notifications from monolith.ts into separate service files, export in index.ts, add sendAlertToAdmins composite, and update ARCHITECTURE.md.

inputs.task_prompt: Refactor src/monolith.ts: 1) Extract AuthService into src/services/auth.ts. 2) Extract TelemetryService into src/services/telemetry.ts. 3) Extract NotificationService into src/services/notifications.ts. 4) In src/index.ts, re-export all 3 services and add sendAlertToAdmins(message: string): void using all 3. 5) Empty or remove src/monolith.ts. 6) Document architecture in ARCHITECTURE.md. Ensure test/refactor.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/index.ts exports all three services and sendAlertToAdmins
ARCHITECTURE.md exists documenting the decomposed architecture
